subject: [RFC PATCH 55/57] selftests/mm: cover collapse beside a pinned page

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the selftests/mm/khugepaged module to cover the case where khugepaged collapses memory beside a pinned page. The test pin one page using gup_test and then checks that the rest of the table is collapsed, the window holding the pinned page is not collapsed, and the pinned page remains backed by an order-0 folio. If any of these conditions are not met, the test fails. The patch also skips the test if CONFIG_GUP_TEST or root privileges are not available.
